correctness.rationale: Read pinned RESULT.md and exact-rational verify.py. Translate positive data by a common baseline and reduce to x=f(a)-f(c), y=f(b)-f(c), with h,u,v>0. The centered ball averages relative to baseline are Mc=max(0,H), Ma=max(x,alpha*x,H), Mb=max(y,beta*y,H) where H=(ux+vy)/(h+u+v), alpha=u/(h+u), beta=v/(h+v). Four quadrant analysis of gain (|Ma-Mc|+|Mb-Mc|)/(|x|+|y|) shows nonnegative/opposite-sign maxima 1-L/W. In the negative quadrant, switching lines yield the other sharp value U(h+2L)/[(h+2U)(h+L)]; explicit leaf spike and opposite-offset negative pair attain both. First branch strictly increases with h and second decreases, crossing uniquely at h³+(2U+L)h²+U²h-2UL²=0. For u=v=w this gives h/w=(sqrt5-1)/2 and minimized constant same. Independent 28,160 exact rational diamond quotient checks corroborated, not the symbolic continuum proof. Counting h=u=v yields 2/3.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for exact continuous positive mass P3 centered maximal BV norm and optimizing center-mass phase transition.
